name: RC Rocket
description: Performance tuning built around Divi. Asset control, media delivery, JavaScript timing and a safety net that switches itself off when something breaks.
changelog:
0.12.6 — A Divi page cached mid-rebuild is cleared from Kinsta two seconds after it is sent, not only by a scheduled task (which often did not run a second time). The version just installed is no longer offered again as an update.
0.12.5 — On Kinsta, a Divi page cached while Divi was rebuilding its CSS is now cleared from Kinsta's cache about 30 seconds later, because Kinsta ignores the no-cache headers 0.12.4 sends.
0.12.4 — Divi pages are no longer cached while Divi is still rebuilding its CSS (the first visit after a plugin update, theme option save or purge), which made pages load unstyled and then jump (layout shift 0.18–0.69 on Divi 4 and Divi 5 test sites) until the cache was cleared again.
0.12.3 — Meta Pixel and Hotjar snippets wait for the visitor's first interaction, like Google Tag Manager (about 520 ms less main-thread work at load on a Divi 4 desktop test), unless another script on the page needs them straight away. Updates need no wp-config.php setup any more; "Get test versions early" in the Safety tab replaces the beta channel line.
0.12.2 — Divi 5 background videos get their section background image as a poster automatically (Divi 5 test site phone hero: 8.5 s with the plugin before, level with the plugin off after). "Hold the video back" no longer breaks Divi 5 videos. Dashboard > Updates > Check again also refreshes RC Rocket's update check.
0.12.1 — New Easy view for non-technical users. Divi features that never switched on (viewport fix, Divi cache clearing, background lazy loading) now do. Google Tag Manager and invisible reCAPTCHA wait for the first interaction (1.4–1.5 s faster LCP on a Divi 4 phone test). Font preloading off by default (measured 330–450 ms faster LCP without it). Images with Divi Supreme's dsm-skip-lazyload class are lazy-loaded again (a portfolio page loaded 4–7 MB more up front). Tracking cookies set from PHP (Meta Pixel's _fbp/_fbc) no longer stop the host caching pages for logged-out visitors. System check no longer blames Cloudflare's __cf_bm cookie for a cache bypass.
0.12.0 — Fixes from a full review before rolling out to every site: hardened error and hero-image beacons, HTTPS-only updates, typed settings import, opt-in database cleanup, page-cache fixes (WP Rocket takeover, path normalisation, Divi Theme Builder purges), safer script delay and lazy loading.
0.11.3 — Fixes from speed testing: scripts called by inline snippets, menu and form plugins are never delayed.
0.11.2 — Diagnostics for jQuery loading, richer error reports, Kinsta cache bypass explanations.
0.11.1 — Fixes from a full code review: Divi builder Heartbeat, local Google Fonts for Divi, XML-RPC off by default.
0.11.0 — Automatic hero (LCP) detection, lazy Divi background images, WordPress Abilities / MCP tools.
0.10.0 — Kinsta single-page purge, per-row Clear cache links, more ignored tracking parameters.
0.9.0 — Per-page options in the editor sidebar.
0.6.4 — Fixed the Plugin Details modal showing a blank description or a stale version number when the cached update-check result predates a plugin update.
0.6.3 — Tested up to WordPress 7.1.
0.6.2 — Plugin URI updated to rhythmco.com. The update manifest can now supply its own description for the Plugin Details modal instead of a hardcoded one.
0.6.1 — GitHub Actions release workflow. Tagging a version lints every file, runs all nine test suites, builds the admin app and attaches the zip to the release.
0.6.0 — Self-hosted updates. Define RC_ROCKET_UPDATE_URL in wp-config.php and every site sees new releases in Dashboard > Updates.
